description: Implement display enumeration for the source picker on Windows. Use Electron's screen.getAllDisplays() augmented with native DXGI adapter/output info from the helper (resolution, refresh rate, HDR capability, scaling factor). Map Electron display IDs to DXGI output indices for capture backend targeting. Handle display hotplug (connect/disconnect monitor during recording), DPI scaling differences per monitor, and virtual desktop arrangements.
title: Windows display and monitor enumeration
